introHtml: Medium-sized buttons, stickers, and patches offer a versatile canvas for your logo or message, large enough to be seen from across a trade show floor but compact enough for easy distribution. Whether you're ordering 3-inch diameter buttons for a political campaign or medium stickers for product labeling, this size strikes the perfect balance between visibility and portability. Ideal for giveaways, fundraising events, or employee recognition, these items can be decorated with full-color printing or foil stamping to make your brand stand out.
